terms.p: A directory with a Cargo.toml that Cargo can build, test and publish, holding at most one library crate and any number of binary crates.
A set of packages sharing one lockfile, one build directory and one set of Cargo commands, so every member resolves to the same version of every dependency.

terms.x: publishing an item at a new path
terms.p: A pub use line that makes an item reachable by a name other than the one its own module gives it, which is how a crate's public API is kept separate from its internal layout.
The small set of standard library names the compiler injects into every module automatically, which is why Option and Vec need no use line.
The convention that a version number says how much a release broke, so a change to anything publicly reachable forces a new major version.

terms.x: who is allowed to name this
terms.p: How far an item can be reached from, ranging from the defining module alone up to every other crate.
The nested arrangement of modules inside one crate, rooted at src/main.rs or src/lib.rs and built out by mod declarations rather than by the filesystem.
